main_body: A tall slot machine cabinet in crimson with a gold header, reel window with three reels, and a coin tray, drawn straight from the front.
top_band: none. The column starts with a gold sign panel (rows 1-5) that is a vertical face, then dark brown rows 6-7. No lighter horizontal top surface is visible.
evidence: Reading down the middle column: gold header panel (rows 1-5), dark brown band, then the crimson face with reel window, buttons and tray, ending in a gold/brown base. The header is a vertical sign face and there is no foreshortened top band over the body. The reel window and tray are painted flat on the face with no inset shading. This matches the front elevation failure in the guide.

style.evidence: The outlines are dark brown or dark red, tinted to match the material, which is good. The crimson body is a large, almost flat fill with only about 3 tones, and the gold header and base are also flat. Detail is limited to the reel window and some pixel accents. Compared with the stall and well references, which have 5-6 steps and grain, it is flatter and carries fewer colours per tile.
